entries.summary: Maintained headless runner crate has no maintained Cargo.lock; initial --locked source-tree build failed before compilation. Successor used an exact-commit temporary archive and generated lockfile with explicit binding; no maintained --locked claim.
First successor recorder invocation used a cwd-relative recorder path and did not start the build.
First unchanged-save SQLite backup produced a zero-byte destination after a transient open failure; successor v2 snapshot passed integrity.

V2 helper incorrectly compared the create-time migration ledger envelope digest with the later solve/save envelope. Successor v3 limits the ledger equality assertion to the persisted post-migration model and documents the temporal envelope scope.

Actual native ResultItem rows carry no dimension field. Stress-neutral witness construction returns zero and validation throws SN-DIAGNOSTIC-WORK-FINDING-MISMATCH; the component catches the error and misleadingly renders its no-result state.

unexercised_review_finding.summary: Fresh review separately identified malformed scalar/array HistoricalRunContext crash risk. This bounded native cut did not inject malformed records and makes no runtime claim for that path.
